name: Unit Dot Census
note: 3,219 canvas dots, one per twenty teams, regroup from a Vogel sunflower into equal-unit columns by region, plan or team size; each dot rides an analytic damped spring with a per-rank delay, colours switch as it departs, and the rAF loop only runs while anything moves. Every facet sums to the same total, so the chart and legend always agree.

name: Milestone Road Trip
note: The road's own horizontal scroller is a named scroll-timeline (lifted to the root with timeline-scope) that animates a registered --bks-road-p: the van follows the road on offset-path, its wheels spin, and each signpost lights over an animation-range ending exactly where the van arrives, computed from the path's arc length; the year and stop count are integer @property values printed with CSS counters. Without scroll timelines, a rAF-throttled scroll handler writes the same variables.
